2609.15533.title: The Misery of Mechanistic Interpretability: A Formal Perspective
2609.15533.paper_summary: Mechanistic interpretability has become the dominant lens for understanding frontier language models, as their inner workings are complex and inherently black boxes. To gain insights into these models, interpretable replacement networks (IRNs) are trained at all layers, exposing interpretable features through sparsely activated neurons. However, the faithfulness of an IRN is usually evaluated only empirically on clean data, and we show that even semantically minor input perturbations flip the dominant IRN features-and thus the human-understandable interpretation-across five open-weight model families (GPT-2 small, Gemma 2 2B, Gemma 3 1B, Llama 3.2 1B, R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B). We propose the first formal verification framework for the faithfulness of an IRN, where reachability analysis certifies a sound upper bound of the faithfulness gap in adversarial scenarios. Moreover, we show that verification-aware training of IRNs substantially tightens this certified bound, restoring a feature-level interpretation that safety auditors can act on. Together, these results give, to the best of our knowledge, the first formal guarantees for mechanistic interpretability of large language models.
2609.15533.paper_summary_zh: 機制可解釋性已成為理解前沿語言模型的主導視角，因為它們的內部運作複雜且本質上是黑箱。為了深入了解這些模型，所有層次的可解釋替代網絡（IRNs）被訓練，通過稀疏激活的神經元揭示可解釋的特徵。然而，IRN的忠實度通常僅在乾淨數據上進行實證評估，我們顯示即使是語義上輕微的輸入擾動也會翻轉主導的IRN特徵——因此人類可理解的解釋——在五個開放權重模型系列中（GPT-2 small, Gemma 2 2B, Gemma 3 1B, Llama 3.2 1B, R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B）。我們提出了首個針對IRN忠實度的正式驗證框架，其中可達性分析認證在對抗場景中忠實度差距的合理上限。此外，我們顯示IRNs的驗證意識訓練顯著收緊了這一認證界限，恢復了安全審計人員可以採取行動的特徵級解釋。綜合這些結果，據我們所知，這是對大型語言模型機制可解釋性的首個正式保證。
2609.15533.author: Tobias Ladner et.al.
